text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Early one morning, while making my way to the Trainer's office, 
I came across Curren Bouquetd'or holding a small pouch and murmuring softly to herself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Mmh—the moisture is completely gone. 
Now all that's left is——
choice_data_list: <size=38>Good morning, Bouquet. What are you up to?</size>
<size=38>Good morning, Bouquet. What are you up to?</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah — good morning. 
With these dried flowers — I was thinking of making some potpourri.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It's like a natural room fragrance made from flowers — and it smells simply wonderful. All that's left is to add a few drops of oil, put them in a jar, and it's finished.
choice_data_list: <size=35>The scent of flowers, huh. It's so calming, I love it</size>
<size=35>The scent of flowers, huh. It's so calming, I love it</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh… In that case, have you visited the academy's flowerbeds recently? There are so many flowers in full bloom right now — and they have such a lovely scent.
choice_data_list: Is that so? Now you've got me curious

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
…If you'd like — would you care to come with me right now? 
I was actually — just heading over to tend to the flowers myself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: This planter over here is jasmine. They're in full bloom right now — and are best known for their sweet fragrance.
choice_data_list: You're right, it smells so good…

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Hehe — it's a very calming scent, isn't it? It's actually quite popular for aromatherapy and perfumes, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Tulips are so vibrant and eye-catching — which is why they're often used in floral arrangements.
choice_data_list: They're all so beautiful… I could look at them forever
They're all so beautiful… I could look at them forever

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Hehe — thank you. Looking at these little flowers always warms my heart, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I truly believe flowers — have the power to heal our hearts. Whether in their blooming forms — or bundled into bouquets and potpourri.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: If through these little creations — I can bring even a little brightness to everyone's hearts — I would be so happy.
choice_data_list: <size=36>(Everyone's hearts, huh… That sounds exactly like Bouquet)</size>
<size=36>(Everyone's hearts, huh… That sounds exactly like Bouquet)</size>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …These flowers must be filled with her gentle, caring nature. Looking around the garden once more—
choice_data_list: Oh… Are these new sprouts?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inside a sunlit planter — several tiny sprouts were peeking their little faces out of the soil.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Those are — dahlias. The bulbs I planted a while back — finally sprouted just the other day.
choice_data_list: I see. I hope they bloom beautifully
I see. I hope they bloom beautifully

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you, so much. They're a birthday present for my mother — so I'm really looking forward to seeing them bloom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: They won't bloom until autumn, so it'll still take some time — but I'm sure they'll make a beautiful bouquet.
choice_data_list: Autumn, huh… Of course, but that's still quite a ways off
Autumn, huh… Of course, but that's still quite a ways off

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes — but watching over them as they grow day by day is so rewarding. Giving them water, pulling out the weeds…

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: And besides — waiting is simply preparation for the joy to come.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Sprouts emerge, buds form, and eventually, flowers bloom. Nurturing flowers — is a continuous cycle of waiting.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: But — because we spent all that time caring for them and waiting, the joy we feel when they finally bloom is so much greater.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: And on top of that — imagining the smile of the person who kindly receives them… that's the true joy of the time spent waiting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She must be used to the waiting involved in nurturing flowers. Even so, wouldn't it be difficult to keep caring for them for so long?
choice_data_list: <size=34>If you'd like… could I help you care for the flowers?</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Eh…?
choice_data_list: I'm just a beginner, but I thought maybe there was something I could do to help

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you so much. 
Your kindness — makes me very happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: But — that's quite alright. I love caring for the flowers, so just the thought alone is more than enough — ah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you'd like — would you please come visit here again? 
I think these little flowers, too… would be so happy if someone else came to look at them.
choice_data_list: I see… Alright, then! I'll come by again

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Insisting on helping would probably just get in her way. After spending a little more time looking at the flowers with her, I made my way back to work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later… Suddenly feeling the urge to see the flowers, I made my way back to the flowerbeds once more. And there—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: The soil is — mmh, it's not dry yet. It doesn't look like they need watering—
choice_data_list: (Ah… It's Bouquet)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Hello there… little dahlias. I'm so glad to see — you're sprouting so nicely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I hope you bloom into beautiful flowers. 
Let's work hard together to make that happen, okay?
choice_data_list: (…Just as I thought…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She is earnestly waiting for the flowers, watching over them with a gentle affection stronger than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that is exactly why — I felt a beginner like me shouldn't needlessly intrude while she cares for the flowers.
choice_data_list: (I'll just quietly watch over her)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if I can't help her directly, there must still be something I can do. With that in mind, I watched from afar as she lovingly gazed at the flowers.
